text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘Diwali’ (दिवाली)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘Diwali’ (Diwali). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘Diwali’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘festival’ मतलब त्योहार। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘festival’ matlab tyohaar. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘festival’ means त्योहार. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘lamps’ मतलब दीये। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘lamps’ matlab diye. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘lamps’ means दीये. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘bright’ मतलब चमकीला। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘bright’ matlab chamkeela. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘bright’ means चमकीला. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: Diwali is the festival of lights.
We clean our house before Diwali.
Mummy makes sweets and Papa brings new clothes for us.
In the evening we light small lamps called diyas.
The whole street looks bright and beautiful.
We wear our new clothes and meet our friends.
I love Diwali, because everyone is happy together.

question.en: Diwali is the festival of what?

question.hi: शाम को वे क्या जलाते हैं?
question.hinglish: Shaam ko woh kya jalaate hain?
question.en: What do they light in the evening?
